messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@medalytics.com>, Tom Blake <tom@medalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot initiation call & prompt-pack sync

Hi Samira / Tom — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the pilot moving: 

- What I heard: Medalytics wants to validate Redwood for anonymized clinical note summarization at scale (target: 10k notes/day), measure latency and token-cost, and run a small prompt-suite to validate extraction accuracy vs your golden set.
- Success criteria we suggested: >= 92% extraction F1 across the prompt set, median token latency < 200ms for interactive validation, and predictable unit cost within the committed pilot pricing band.

Proposed next meeting: Pilot initiation (45 min) — tech deep dive + prompt-pack walkthrough + success criteria alignment. Please pick one of these slots: 
  • Wed Mar 24: 10:00–10:45 PT
  • Wed Mar 24: 14:00–14:45 PT
  • Thu Mar 25: 11:30–12:15 PT

I attached a short pilot plan (pilot_plan_v1.xlsx) and the first draft of the prompt pack (rdw_prompt_pack_v1.pdf) so you have context before the call. For the kickoff we plan to cover: kickoff objectives, trial data and ingestion options, prompt/eval pass, and roles/owners. 

If any of those windows don't work, propose a couple times and we will accommodate. Also, Tom — you mentioned a brief legal checklist and SOC2 evidence request; can you forward that to Ben and Marissa so we can include security/compliance coverage in the kickoff?

Thanks — Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra

Tom, copying you to confirm anyone else on our side who should join (I expect Alex from Data Ops and Priya from Security).

Samira
